thread:
dev-bot: Initiating slow-burn region rollout for release/v2.18.1. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC. Change window 01:30-05:30 UTC. Initial slice 3%, ramp steps 3/30/100, hold window 20m. Rollback/guardrails: 5xx >= 0.4% sustained for 15m OR p95 >= 700ms for 3m OR >=2 host OOMs in 10m. Auto-route to regional-quant variant allowed. Please ack with capacity readouts.
alex: Ack. I'll kick off warm pool + cache prefill for US (target warm GPUs = 18). Posting smoke in ~5m.
priya: Quick note: some EU dedicated tenants have spike reservations tonight; recommend EU start later in window if headroom <15%.
marco: Running capacity probe now. Current spare headroom: US 22%, EU 14%, APAC 9%. Will push reclaimed nodes if needed.
tina: Tagging infra: APAC kernel matrix shows mixed CUDA drivers on apac-edge-2. If we use new fused-gemm path, risk of kernel_error. Consider excluding apac-edge-2 from early waves.
marco: Smoke results (US): p95=110ms, 5xx=0.03% ; EU baseline p95=150ms, 5xx=0.04% ; APAC baseline p95=420ms, 5xx=0.12%.
alex: Starting US at 3% now.
alex: `deploy start --wave us --pct 3 --version v2.18.1 --pin release/v2.18.1`
dev-bot: US wave started @1735009999. Hooks: metrics-agent, rollout-trace, eval-runner. Alert channel set to #eng-oncall. Wave hold timeout 20m.
ops-bot: Oncall notified. Will escalate if thresholds crossed.
priya: I'll watch customer quota metrics for EU and APAC. If reserved utilization >80% in region -> signal soft-pin.
marco: US T+8m: small GPU thermal on us-east-1a, drained pod, p95 up to 135ms then recovered. No 5xx.
alex: Bumping US to 30% now.
alex: `deploy continue --wave us --pct 30`
dev-bot: US to 30% completed. Rollback command available: `deploy rollback --to v2.17.9 --pin release/v2.17.9`. Manual fallbacks: regional-quant, model-shim.
tina: Adding auto-fallback rule for APAC: if p95 > 500ms for 5m -> route APAC traffic to v2.18-quant within 3m.
marco: EU reclaim in progress; headroom after reclaim projected ~20% (if reclaim completes).
alex: EU scheduled to start +40m. APAC planned last, with preflight quota reclaim.
priya: EU warmpool request: 10 GPUs. Will attempt to reserve. If reservation fails because of Dedicated commitments, we'll delay EU start.
marco: EU warmpool confirmed 10 GPUs. Final EU smoke: p95=170ms, 5xx=0.01%.
dev-bot: Starting EU 3% @1735011200. Monitoring enabled.
marco: EU T+12m: a single backend reported 503s due to infra-side healthcheck flapping (likely unrelated), p95 steady. Keeping an eye.
alex: Rolling EU to 30% per plan.
priya: APAC reclaim started. Note: APAC has two hosts with older NVIDIA stacks; infra action: mark as no-canary for this rollout.
tina: Confirmed. apac-edge-2 excluded from canary and warm pool.
marco: APAC warmpool final: 14 GPUs, warm p95=230ms, 5xx=0.02%. Good to start.
dev-bot: Starting APAC 3% @1735013000. Guardrails in place: kernel_error >=2 per-host -> immediate route to quant variant and page infra.
marco: APAC T+6m spike: p95 climbs to 560ms; dev-bot auto-fallback condition met (p95>500ms for 5m), routing APAC -> v2.18-quant.
alex: Confirmed auto-fallback applied. APAC p95 drops back to ~210ms. No customer-visible errors reported.
priya: Logging: APAC fallback, driver mismatch flags on apac-edge-2. Recommend infra repro and driver rolling upgrade tomorrow.
marco: Rollout summary: US 100% @1735012000, EU 100% @1735012900, APAC 100% @1735013600 (APAC served via v2.18-quant after fallback). Closing thread. Follow-ups: infra to triage apac driver matrix, ops to add note on quota guard for EU dedicated tenants, release notes to mention APAC fallback and warmpool sizes.
infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-9832: "APAC driver repro and node-pool upgrade". Linked to rollout 1735009999.
ops-bot: Acks recorded. No incident opened; alerting will auto-create if thresholds reoccur.
alex: I'll add the rollout bullet to release notes and attach smoke logs: s3://redwood-rollouts/1735009999/v2.18.1-smoke/{us.log,eu.log,apac.log}. Great job everyone. :tada:
priya: Adding action item: revisit regional soft-pin thresholds (80% -> 75%) for next release.
